about: Groups fields that belong together under one name. Disabling the group disables every control in it, and the group's size reaches every field that states none.
none: Fill in both before going on.

orientation.about: The fields one under another, and side by side. Side by side, the fields wrap from a 12rem basis, and the legend and the texts take a row each.
orientation.title: Orientations

reported.error: Choose how you want to pay.
reported.warning: We could not reach this number last time.

size.about: Every size. The legend reads the label role at the size, the texts read the body role one size smaller, and the fields inside take the size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: Rest, disabled and invalid. A disabled group disables every control in it and leaves the legend enabled. An invalid group renders its error text with `role="alert"`.
states.title: States

status.about: One group per status. A status sets the ink of the error text, which leads with a mark so the four read apart without color. Only the error marks the group invalid.
status.title: Statuses

title: Fieldset
